defs.def: being a woman or a girl 女的；女性的

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在她的研究中，Martin让参与者对他们与男性、女性和无性别版本的数字语音助手以及一辆名为"Miuu"的自动驾驶汽车的依恋程度进行评分。研究发现，性别增加了用户对这些设备的依恋感和购买兴趣。

ex.s: For example, participants said they would be less likely to buy a genderless voice assistant than versions with male or female voices.
ex.t: 它们也更清楚地知道自己知道什么和不知道什么。

ex.s: Similarly, anthropomorphized products could be created to take on stereotype-inconsistent roles — a male robot that assists with nursing or a female robot that helps do calculations, for instance.
ex.t: 因此，他们拥有清晰和自信的优势。

ex.s: The concept ___62___ (be) certainly not new — men have been renting good suits for decades — but for female shoppers, it is just taking off.
ex.t: 生态机器中的植物和动物把淤泥当作食物，开始吃掉它！

ex.s: It is gaining popularity among females.
ex.t: 它在女性中越来越受欢迎。

ex.s: 37     Our building even had a tiny lift with a female voice that said, “Ouverture des portes,” in perfect French.
ex.t: 这是我唯一学会的法语短语，遗憾的是我没有太多机会使用它。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合放归保护区的野外区域还为时过早。

ex.s: They can even distinguish their mother’s voice from that of a female stranger.
ex.t: 它们甚至能区分母亲的声音和女性陌生人的声音。

defs.def: of the sex that can lay eggs or give birth to babies 雌的；母的

ex.s: Female Australian superb fairy wrens were found to repeat one sound over and over again while hatching their eggs.
ex.t: 新兴巨头的出现表明新来者也能掀起波澜。

defs.def: of women; typical of women; affecting women 女性的；妇女的；女性特有的

ex.s: The voices themselves sounded really unique-some of the female voices were so high that I was sure they could break glass!
ex.t: 声音本身听起来非常独特——一些女声高得我确信它们可以震碎玻璃！

ex.s: In 1846, they paid to publish their own poetry, and like many of their female contemporaries they used male names to do this.
ex.t: 1846年，她们自己出资出版了诗集，和许多同代女性一样，她们使用男性笔名。

ex.s: It is perhaps the longest species of monkey and also one of the heaviest: a male’s body length can reach 50–115 cm, with a tail length of 45–84 cm, while it can weigh 21– 45 kg; a female’s body weight can range 12–25 kg.
ex.t: 它可能是最长的猴类物种，也是最重的之一：雄性的体长可达50-115厘米，尾长45-84厘米，体重可达21-45公斤；雌性的体重范围是12-25公斤。

ex.s: She applied to become a paratrooper in 1961, but her first application failed because there were no female paratroopers at that time.
ex.t: 她于1961年申请成为伞兵，但第一次申请失败了，因为当时没有女性伞兵。

ex.s: She completed over 140 parachute jumps over a period of 20 years – the most of any female paratrooper.
ex.t: 她在二十年间完成了140多次跳伞——是所有女性伞兵中最多的。
